rows.meaning: person named in a will or trust
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who receives benefits from a will, trust, or insurance policy.

example.english: The will states that I am the beneficiary of this estate.
example.traditional: 份遺囑寫明，我係呢筆遺產嘅受益人。
example.jyutping: fan2 wai4 zuk1 se2 ming4 ngo5 hai6 ni1 bat1 wai4 caan2 ge3 sau6 jik1 jan4

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean the person entitled to an insurance payout rather than a beneficiary generally.

example.english: The policy states that I am the sole beneficiary of the insurance.
example.traditional: 份保單寫明我係唯一嘅保險受益人。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou2 daan1 se2 ming4 ngo5 hai6 wai4 jat1 ge3 bou2 him2 sau6 jik1 jan4
